thread.title: Dow Jones, Stock Market Extend Win Streaks | Investor's Business Daily

author: SCOTT LEHTONEN
title: Dow Jones, Stock Market Extend Win Streaks | Investor's Business Daily
text:
The major stock indexes extended their win streaks Wednesday morning in today's stock market . The Dow Jones industrials advanced more than 100 points. Three days of midlevel trade talks between the U.S. and China ended Wednesday; both countries will release a message at the same time Thursday morning. Meanwhile, credit rating agency Fitch warned that the U.S. is in danger of losing its Triple-A sovereign credit rating due to the ongoing government shutdown. Tech giant Amazon.com ( AMZN ) reversed lower, while Apple ( AAPL ) looked to shrug off more bad news.
X The tech-heavy Nasdaq composite gained 0.6%. The S&P 500 index added 0.4%, while the Dow Jones industrials also added 0.6%. ( For updates on this story and other market coverage, visit the Stock Market Today page.)
Dow Jones Extends Win Streak Last Friday, the Dow Jones industrials triggered a bullish market signal , according to the IBD Big Picture . Check out the Stocks Near A Buy Zone column for potential stock ideas that are currently setting up. But don't be too aggressive , not all follow-through days are successful and it can take time for meaningful upside progress.
The Dow Jones industrial average moved up for a fourth straight trading session and is about 10% off the price lows set on Dec. 26. The Dow is approaching its 50-day moving average line, a potential resistance level. The 50-day line is priced around 24,400, about 2% above the current level.

Please contact customer service CLOSE Amazon Stock Down; Apple Stock Up FANG stock Amazon.com reversed from early gains to fall 0.2%. Amazon.com stock reclaimed its 50-day moving average line Monday. Fellow FANG stock Netflix ( NFLX ) risked snapping a nine-day win streak, falling 0.8%. Netflix stock is already about 36% above its low price set on Dec. 26.
Apple stock reversed from early losses to gain 0.9% after Japan's Nikkei reported that Apple is cutting iPhone production by 10% between January and March. Shares of the iPhone maker are about 35% off its 52-week high.
Dow Jones stock and IBD 50 member Intel ( INTC ) was one of the top performers among the Dow 30. Shares moved up 0.8% and are rising further above their 50-day line. The 200-day line looms ahead as a potential resistance level.
Stock Market Earnings: Constellation Sinks Early Wednesday, beer and wine company Constellation Brands ( STZ ) reported disappointing full-year profit guidance . Shares sank 9% to hit a new 52-week low.
Earnings season is rapidly approaching. Next week, a slew of companies will be reporting earnings, including Dow Jones stocks JPMorgan ( JPM ), Goldman Sachs ( GS ) and American Express ( AXP ).
IBD 50 Stocks To Watch: Xilinx Snaps Back Among the leading growth stocks , Xilinx ( XLNX ) advanced over 1% to continue its move up the right side of a new base formation. The chip stock fell almost 2% Tuesday after Goldman Sachs said it expects another challenging year for semiconductor stocks.
On the downside, Wingstop ( WING ) fell nearly 1%. The chicken wings-focused restaurant is about 4% away from a 72.11 buy point.
